title: chore(objectui): bump the console pin past objectui `c096f03` — it carries objectui#11611, #11614 and #11619, which unlock #21714, #21765 and #21768
body:
Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`: the foreseen follow-up of three blocked cards whose unlock is the install face. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

## Why

Three objectstack cards wait on `.objectui-sha`, not on objectui merging (the cross-repo unlock reads the install face):

| card | waits for objectui | merge on objectui `main` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| #21714 (`reportForm` joined-block `dataset` row) | PR #11611, the `ref:dataset` widget | `b508ac50d9` |
| #21768 (runtime form field, the grid's camelCase keys) | PR #11614, the eight-key rename | `2abec3a9` |
| #21765 (`object.imageField` → `live`) | PR #11619, the record chip's image | `c096f03` |

`.objectui-sha` is `2e818d0b51ec` (read in this round). objectui `main` is `c096f032793d`, 14 commits ahead, and carries all three.

## Change

- Move `.objectui-sha` to objectui `main` at or after `c096f03`, through the repo's pin tooling.
- **The PR lists every objectui change the bump carries, with its declared disposition, as #21696 did.** Name each declared-breaking change, and say how this repo answers it. #11614's snake_case → camelCase rename of the grid keys is one: objectui refuses the old spellings by name.
- **Acceptance:** CI and `Console Pin Gate` are green, with a browser smoke of the record page that #11619 changes.

## Order against the release

**Release first.** objectstack 17.7.0's version PR (#21352) is ready and waits on the maintainer. A pin bump merged before that release would force another version-PR refresh. So this lands after 17.7.0 is published, unless the maintainer wants these three in 17.7.

`tooling` · `priority:p2` (it unblocks three cards) · `domain:devx` (the pin lane, as #21696) · `area:devpath`.
